definitions.explanation: free items given as promotional gifts, lottery prizes, or bonus items with purchases

examples.japanese: ⟦{抽選|ちゅうせん}→抽選：07054_chuusen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{景品|けいひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: I won a prize in the lottery.
Many people buy just to get the promotional gifts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{景品|けいひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いてくる→付いてくる：29670_tsuitekuru⟧。
examples.english: This product comes with a free gift.

notes:
FORMS:
{景|けい} (scene, appearance) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (item) → gift item (originally items displayed for show)

TYPES OF {景品|けいひん}:
- ⟦{抽選|ちゅうせん}→抽選：07054_chuusen⟧{景品|けいひん} (lottery prize)
- ⟦{購入|こうにゅう}{特典|とくてん}→購入特典：26657_kounyuutokuten⟧ (purchase bonus)
- ノベルティ (novelty/promotional item)
- ⟦おまけ→おまけ：08160_omake⟧ (freebie/bonus - more casual)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {景品|けいひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (to win a prize)
- {景品|けいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧ (to distribute promotional gifts)
- {景品|けいひん}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧ (with a free gift)

LEGAL CONTEXT:
In Japan, there are regulations called {景品|けいひん}{表示法|ひょうじほう} (Premium Labeling Law) that limit the value of promotional gifts to prevent unfair competition.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦おまけ→おまけ：08160_omake⟧ (bonus item - more casual)
- ⟦{賞品|しょうひん}→賞品：21558_shouhin⟧ (prize - for competitions)
- ⟦{特典|とくてん}→特典：13469_tokuten⟧ (special benefit/bonus)
